s: Beezeh open maqnin haerub ubo seip echad: hannoten maot lenachtom, veamar lo: im yabou bene hechatzer liqnot mimmeka kikkar leerub, zekeh li baerub, sheyyehe li cheleq immahem, bishbil maa zo — eno erub lezeh, shemmaot enan qonot ad sheyyimshok. Vaapillu im zikka hannachtom hakkikkar lekol bene hechatzer kullam biklal al yede acher bemattenat chinnam, vahare gam zeh hu mikkelal bene hechatzer, venitkavven hannachtom sheggam zeh yizkeh veyihyeh lo cheleq bekikkar zeh — mikkol maqom lo nitkavven hannachtom sheyyizkeh bo zeh al yede hazzokeh, sheyyehe naaseh shelucho kemo shennaaseh shaliach lekol shear bene hechatzer shemmezakkeh lahem hannachtom bemattenat chinnam, ella daat hannachtom hu shezzeh yesh lo kebar zekut bekikkar zeh bishbil hammaa shennatan lo, velishar bene hechatzer — shennoten lahem mattenat chinnam — lahem bilbaddam hu sheoseh et hazzokeh shaliach sheyyizkeh bishbilam. Abal lezeh eno osehu shaliach kelal, venimtza sheen lo cheleq baerub (abal im yesh bedato sheyyihyeh hazzokeh shaliach lezeh kemo lishar bene hechatzer — qana erub). Veim amar lo "areb li" — qana erub bekol inyan im zikka lekol bene hechatzer kullam biklal, shehare asao shaliach leareb lo beinyan sheyyoil. Vekevan shei epshar lihyot lo erub ella im ken yezakkeh lo al yede acher, kemo laacherim shello natenu maot — hare zeh keillu amar lo sheyyezakkeh lo al yede acher kemo laacherim, velo yizkeh bemaa bilbaddah. Vachazaqa shaliach oseh shelichuto. Vaapillu im amar "zekeh li" — im natan lo keli sheyyaqneh lo betorat qinyan sudar, qana erub. Veim natan maa lebaal habbayit, veamar lo "zekeh li baerub" — qana erub, lepi sheen derek baal habbayit limkor pat mishshello, uledaat sheyyiqneh lo bemaotayv pat min hashshuq amar lo ken, ukeillu amar "areb li", sheasao shaliach leareb. Vachazaqa shaliach oseh shelichuto, umin hassetam qana lo vezaka bishbilo, o zikka lo al yede acher mishshello:
